description:
What really happens when the power goes out? Hour by hour.

Hours Without makes realistic, animated blackout and outage simulations: grid down, winter storms, no heat, no water. You face the decisions, pick your move, then see what the data says: what fails first, what actually helps, and where people go wrong.

No doomsday hype. Every video lists its sources in the description.

The scenarios and characters are fictional; the numbers and safety guidance are real and sourced. General information and entertainment, not professional emergency advice.

New here? Start with the featured video. Subscribe for the next simulation.

What Happens If the Power Grid Goes Down for 2 Weeks? (Hour by Hour)
